description: Get live price and delivery estimates for professional human translation, certified and sworn translation, MTPE, revision, and website or CMS localization. Choose the languages, volume, subject area and urgency to receive an estimated price in EUR and delivery time. This plugin provides quotations only and does not create orders or process payments.
